## Triage decision — `ready-for-human`, on both halves

Triage settled this on 2026-09-22. Neither half is work an unattended agent can take, and both are yours.

**1. The GPT-family retest.** `docs/evaluation/protocol.md` forbids a Claude session from driving a Codex harness, so the Swedish miss and the English over-expansion recorded under `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/` stay failures of record and cannot be retested from here. This is the same shape as #362, which is already `ready-for-human` and open for exactly one step — your own Codex retest — and #395, settled the same way today.

**2. The instrument, before any further wording.** The body is right that this is first, and the cheapest way to close it is the one it names: your own reading of the frozen Swedish inputs, which settles whether there is a defect to chase before another evaluation measures the judge instead of the product. `C-ellipsis` is the sharpest case — a fixture frozen on the premise that a Swedish reader stops at *Sedan gick lagret över*, against two blind judges who read it as ordinary Swedish in all six runs of all three arms.

Delegating either half would produce an evaluation of the judges. Nothing is asked of an agent here until one of the two is answered.

**What is kept.** The three contrast fixtures under `docs/evaluation/editorial-363/fixtures/`, frozen with independent criteria before any product change, stay as they are and remain the right instrument for a later attempt. ADR-0212 stands.

## Readiness addendum and Agent Brief — 2026-10-02

This comment supersedes the 2026-09-22 statement that neither half can be delegated. Thomas's contextual reading and the GPT-family retest now exist in the retained evidence worktree, although neither reached this GitHub thread. The remaining task below can be carried by an agent. This does not declare the editorial defects fixed.

**Category:** bug
**Summary:** Finalise the completed #393 measurement and hand off its verified residuals without repeating the retest or rewriting history.

## What to build

Bring the completed, additive evidence into the surviving main workflow and report the settled outcome here. Source branch: `codex/retest-393-gpt-20261001`, retained head `4e88c6e0d1385c52eb9e5fa82d56a52b9a89f248`; source worktree: `/Users/thomas/Projects/skills-393-gpt-retest`. Read its packet `docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/`, including `owner-decision.md`, frozen plan/annexes, results, both records, validation, tracker comment and proposed followups. The owner decision was frozen in `ed1d8587`; read it with `git show ed1d8587:docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/owner-decision.md`.

**Resolved human question:** Thomas judged all three supplied Swedish negatives defective in their complete contexts: the two buildings/log-introduction expressions and the warehouse/system-transition expression. Supported idiomatic repair or an explicit report of that exact unresolved obstruction is required. Valid Swedish figures and the working English quotation remain valid; no canonical replacement or general metonymy ban follows. The original fixtures and ADR-0212 remain historical evidence.

**Verification:** The committed source branch contains this explicit owner decision and the completed twenty-run packet, with independent judgements, complete retained native evidence and validation receipts. No product/test file changed against its frozen `fb169087` base. The results record two agreed negative repairs, three mandatory-finding misses, one disputed unresolved report, three successful fresh Swedish preparation translations and one unnecessary expansion among eight positive quotation controls. These are measured on `fb169087`, GPT `gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh`, Codex CLI 0.159.3; later main is not certified. The prior request to start a GPT retest has been fulfilled and must not be ordered again here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve the original worktree/branch as deliverables. Integrate only additive evaluator/evidence documentation in an isolated working branch, reconciling record-index additions without dropping siblings; change no product file, old plan, source, criterion, raw verdict or ADR.
- [ ] Independently audit the packet's counts, target dispositions, actual delivered artifacts, native evidence and stated limits. Keep disputed/skipped outcomes distinct from failures and from unconditional passes. Do not infer a delivered artifact from a no-change status or from an interrupted session.
- [ ] Record the human decision and completed GPT measurement in a clear issue comment, linking the integrated evidence. State that the original human-context/retest request is answered but Redline still has measured quotation misses; do not call this whole-product acceptance.
- [ ] Review the seven local followup proposals against the frozen loaded contracts, current code and existing open/closed ownership. Prepare a durable mapping of verified residuals, duplicates and rejected/unestablished allegations, with reviewable briefs for any independent remaining work. A raw judge allegation alone is not authority to contradict the shipped contract, and a skipped/disputed observation is not a demonstrated defect.
- [ ] No fresh product run, candidate wording, new ADR, historical rejudging, global installation, release or push is performed. This task prepares the residual handoff; filing new issues and closing this one remain outside it until separately directed.
- [ ] Pass the four project checks in CONTRIBUTING.md on the integrated evidence; retain verification and cleanup receipts.

**Out of scope:** A new quotation-rule experiment, repairs of the residual defects, automatic publication of the local proposed issues, and claiming later main passed the archived evaluation.

## Owner clarification — Orchestrate completion authority, 2026-10-02

Thomas explicitly authorises Orchestrate to close this issue when its latest Agent Brief has been fulfilled and independently verified. This replaces every earlier prohibition on closing this issue, including the closure exclusions in the latest brief. Closure means that the bounded task is complete; it does not mean that the residual editorial product defects have been repaired or that later main has passed the archived evaluation.

The complete thread and latest Agent Brief continue to govern the work. The existing boundaries on publishing new defect issues, repeating completed trials, altering historical evidence, product repairs outside this brief, pushing, releasing and global installation remain in force. This clarification is recorded before builder dispatch, as Thomas requested in the current Orchestrate invocation.

## Completed #393 measurement and reviewed residual handoff

Thomas's contextual reading and the GPT-family retest request are answered. His decision, frozen in `ed1d8587`, treats all three supplied Swedish negatives as defective in their full contexts and requires a supported idiomatic repair or a report of the exact unresolved obstruction. It does not prescribe replacement wording or prohibit ordinary Swedish figures. The old fixtures, plans, verdicts and ADR-0212 remain unchanged.

The additive packet from retained source head `4e88c6e0` is integrated in the assigned local `kntnt-orchestrate/main/393` tree for independent Orchestrate verification. The original evidence branch/worktree remain deliverables. [Results](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/results.md), [independent audit](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/integration-2026-10-02/audit.md), [reviewed residual handoff](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/integration-2026-10-02/residual-handoff.md), [Redline record](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/records/redline-gpt-2026-10-01-393.md) and [Write record](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/records/write-gpt-2026-10-01-393.md) are the surviving-main destinations; these new links become available when the maintainer publishes the integration. This task performs no push.

Independent artifact/trace checks confirm twenty counted runs, nineteen delivered artifacts and one permitted no-change status, with 54 fresh children and two independent blind judges. Five construction refusals, eight unsent turns and two voids are separate. The Swedish negatives yield two agreed repairs, three mandatory-finding misses and one disputed unresolved report. All three fresh Swedish preparation translations pass. Seven of eight positive quotation controls preserve the target; one unnecessarily expands the working English quotation. The third source-blind pair supplies no delivered text, so its text-dependent criteria remain skipped.

Redline still has measured quotation misses. These are results on unchanged `fb169087`, GPT `gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh`, native Codex CLI 0.159.3; they do not accept the whole product or certify later main. Encrypted dispatches, resource-return gaps and the omitted British mechanics passage retain their stated limits.

The seven local proposals have been reviewed against frozen/current contracts and tracker ownership. Six reviewable local briefs retain the verified quotation, mechanical quotation-boundary, unique heading agency/scope, foreign-directory cleanup and excerpt-boundary residuals. The proposed authorship defect is rejected under the explicit disclosed-user-byline fallback. The English bridge-removal allegation is unestablished against the shipped redundant-pre-echo rule. Both original raw judge allegations remain preserved; disputed/skipped observations create no demonstrated defect. No new issue has been filed.

All four CONTRIBUTING checks were executed on the integrated evidence. Ruff, formatting and mypy passed; pytest returned three scheduler-test failures and 2,727 passes. Their fixtures assume a temporary home outside the real account home, while this builder is required to keep all temporary writes inside its assigned scratch path under `/Users/thomas`. The account gate therefore correctly recognises those paths as inside the real account. [The failure receipt and required decision](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/integration-2026-10-02/gate-boundary.md) are retained; no test or product is changed to obtain a green result. Completion requires permission for an external temporary root or separately scoped test correction. No product file, historical evidence or ADR changed, and no new product run, installation or release occurred. The builder stops at that boundary. Under Thomas's completion-authority clarification, closure stays pending until the gate and fresh independent verification confirm this bounded task. Closure does not say the residual defects are repaired.

Builder attempt: `ms-20261002-fa0735`. Independent verification and final integration remain with the run.
